topic_thesis: Opening a disguised 'wedding invite' or 'utility bill' sent by a trusted family member on WhatsApp can silently execute a trojan script that empties your linked bank accounts in under 180 seconds.
strategic_angle: Expose the brutal reality that banks will deny 100% of fraud claims under 'gross negligence' when users accidentally grant Accessibility permissions to disguised .BAT or .APK scripts, allowing hackers to read OTPs and drain savings in real-time.
key_statistic: ₹2.4 Lakhs drained in 180 seconds / 0% Bank refund liability
target_emotion: Immediate paranoia and urgent urge to audit family WhatsApp downloads
pinned_comment_text: Did your family WhatsApp group receive a random 'Wedding Invite' or 'Challan' attachment recently? Comment 'SECURITY' and I will DM you the 3-step Android kill-switch checklist to secure your banking apps! 👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Frame it around Tamil family WhatsApp groups forwarding 'Kalyana Pathirikai' or 'EB Bill Update'. Use hard-hitting Tanglish hooks like 'Kudumba Group-la vanda file open panningala? Bank balance gaali!' and break down 'Accessibility Permission Aabathu'.
source_signal: Hyderabad Cyber Crimes Unit advisory on weaponized WhatsApp script payloads
